notes: Measured on final-empty.jpg (Gemini's emptied repaint of final-mock.jpg; the frame sits about 2 px from the mock's). socket r is the dark glass disc inside the gold ring; the ivory halo ring reaches r ~242, flush with the bar's top and bottom. Contrast is the WCAG ratio of white and of gold (255,204,110) against the mean luminance of the lightest tenth of x 840-1520, y 410-660 (L 0.027). The well (~46 grey, faint violet) is close to the slate background, so key out by flood fill from the canvas edge, not by colour. Animatable layers: the faint shadow-violet glow hugging the well's inner edge (slow breathing pulse); the gold sunburst boss of the end cap (soft light sweep or glow pulse); the engraved rays of the halo ring round the socket (a slow shimmer travelling round); a pearly sheen sweeping left to right along the ivory bands; the sheen on the empty socket glass.
